mapper.select: SELECT h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, h.customer_id AS customerId, h.status AS status, h.delivery_place AS deliveryPlace, h.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod FROM tb_sales_order_hd h WHERE h.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' FOR UPDATE OF h

SELECT h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, d.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, h.customer_id AS customerId, d.material_id AS materialId, d.order_qty AS orderQty, COALESCE(d.shipped_qty, 0) AS shippedQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM tb_sales_order_dt d JOIN tb_sales_order_hd h ON h.sales_order_id = d.sales_order_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.sales_order_detail_id = #{salesOrderDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND d.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y'

SELECT h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, od.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, pd.sales_delivery_plan_detail_id AS salesDeliveryPlanDetailId, h.customer_id AS customerId, od.material_id AS materialId, od.order_qty AS orderQty, COALESCE(od.shipped_qty, 0) AS shippedQty, pd.planned_qty AS plannedQty, pd.delivered_qty AS deliveredQty, pd.planned_qty - pd.delivered_qty AS remainingQty, od.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM tb_sales_delivery_plan_dt pd JOIN tb_sales_delivery_plan_hd ph ON ph.sales_delivery_plan_id = pd.sales_delivery_plan_id AND ph.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id AND ph.sales_order_id = pd.sales_order_id AND ph.use_at = 'Y' JOIN tb_sales_order_hd h ON h.sales_order_id = pd.sales_order_id AND h.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id AND h.use_at = 'Y' JOIN tb_sales_order_dt od ON od.sales_order_detail_id = pd.sales_order_detail_id AND od.sales_order_id = pd.sales_order_id AND od.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id AND od.material_id = pd.material_id WHERE pd.sales_delivery_plan_detail_id = #{salesDeliveryPlanDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND pd.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND pd.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE OF pd

INSERT INTO tb_sales_delivery_dt ( sales_delivery_id, tenant_id, delivery_type, line_no, material_id, sales_order_id, sales_order_detail_id, sales_delivery_plan_detail_id, delivery_qty, unit_price, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt ) VALUES ( #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{deliveryType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lineNo}, #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{salesOrderDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{salesDeliveryPlanDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{deliveryQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) RETURNING sales_delivery_detail_id

SELECT h.sales_delivery_id AS salesDeliveryId, h.delivery_no AS deliveryNo, h.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, h.delivery_type AS deliveryType, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, h.delivery_place AS deliveryPlace, h.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, h.remark AS remark, h.total_amt AS totalAmt, h.created_by AS createdBy FROM tb_sales_delivery_hd h JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_sales_order_hd o ON o.sales_order_id = h.sales_order_id AND o.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y'

SELECT h.sales_delivery_id AS salesDeliveryId, h.delivery_type AS deliveryType, h.customer_id AS customerId, h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, h.created_by AS createdBy FROM tb_sales_delivery_hd h WHERE h.sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' FOR UPDATE OF h

SELECT d.sales_delivery_detail_id AS salesDeliveryDetailId, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, d.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, d.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, d.sales_delivery_plan_detail_id AS salesDeliveryPlanDetailId, d.delivery_qty AS deliveryQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, d.vat_amt AS vatAmt, d.total_amt AS totalAmt FROM tb_sales_delivery_dt d LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY d.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sales_delivery_plan_dt SET delivered_qty = delivered_qty + #{deltaQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sales_delivery_plan_detail_id = #{salesDeliveryPlanDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND delivered_qty + #{deltaQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC} >= 0 AND (#{deltaQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC} <= 0 OR delivered_qty + #{deltaQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC} <= planned_qty OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = tb_sales_delivery_plan_dt.tenant_id AND t.use_at = 'Y' AND t.over_delivery_policy = 'WARN' ))

UPDATE tb_sales_delivery_hd SET delivery_dt = CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), delivery_place = #{deliveryPlace}, delivery_method = #{deliveryMethod}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_sales_delivery_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

SELECT h.sales_delivery_id AS salesDeliveryId, d.sales_delivery_detail_id AS salesDeliveryDetailId, h.delivery_no AS deliveryNo, h.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, h.delivery_type AS deliveryType, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, h.delivery_place AS deliveryPlace, h.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, h.remark AS remark, h.created_by AS createdBy, COALESCE(h.created_by = #{userId}, FALSE) AS writer, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, d.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, d.delivery_qty AS deliveryQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, d.vat_amt AS vatAmt, d.total_amt AS totalAmt FROM tb_sales_delivery_hd h JOIN tb_sales_delivery_dt d ON d.sales_delivery_id = h.sales_delivery_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_sales_order_hd o ON o.sales_order_id = h.sales_order_id AND o.tenant_id = h.tenant_id JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.delivery_dt BETWEEN CAST(#{deliveryDtFrom} AS date) AND CAST(#{deliveryDtTo} AS date)
AND h.delivery_type = #{deliveryType}
AND (c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{customerKeyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{customerKeyword} || '%')
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND h.delivery_no ILIKE '%' || #{deliveryNo} || '%'
AND (h.delivery_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY h.delivery_dt DESC, h.sales_delivery_id DESC, d.line_no
